Floe Agent

An on-device AI workspace for iOS, iPadOS and Android.

Your models. Your files. Your machines.

Floe Agent is an open-source AI agent for iOS, iPadOS and Android. Work with documents, code and creative projects in one place, with a real Linux environment running on your device. Designed primarily for iPadOS and Apple Pencil, with native iPhone support and Android-specific device workflows.

Get started

Self-signing stores: setup and source URL

Use the Self-signing button above, choose Feather or AltStore on the shared page, then follow your signing method.

Or copy the source URL manually:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JiangNanGenius/floe-agent/main/feather.json

Source and signing guide

Your first task: install Floe → configure a model → create a task → open the resulting file. Start with the quickstart, or choose the iOS/iPadOS or Android guide. Basic document and file work can be used without an AI provider; AI actions use the model you configure.

Features

Workflows vary by platform and release. Choose the build described in the linked guide and its release notes.

On-device work, with your own models

Floe's workspaces and persistent Linux environment run on your hardware. Run shell commands, Python, Node, packages and local web services, then keep the files and execution history with the task. The environment image is downloaded separately; packages must support its architecture.

For AI, connect your own cloud provider using an API key (BYOK: bring your own key). Supported iOS/iPadOS devices can also use Apple's system model or downloaded local models in Beta. Android currently uses cloud providers. Device memory, model readiness and the selected release determine which local options are available.

Workflow What you can do Guide
AI tasks & development Bring materials, tool actions and output files together; use the terminal, code editor, Git and local previews. Tasks · Linux & development
Notes & Office Import PDFs and images, annotate with Pencil on iPad, ask about documents, and edit DOCX, XLSX and PPTX. Notes · Office
Drawings & 3D On iOS/iPadOS, edit 2D drawings and native 3D models, continue with the work assistant, and present or export the result. 2D drawings · 3D workbench
Canvas & media Organize material on a canvas and work on image, video and audio projects in dedicated editors. Canvas & media
Voice & meetings Dictate drafts, hold voice conversations, record meetings, transcribe and organize notes with your selected services. Voice · Meeting workflows
Skills & automation Discover reviewed skills, manage their dependencies and versions, and connect configured MCP and automation services. Skill Hub on the web · Skills & MCP

Space and specialist workbenches add workflows for diagrams, music, LaTeX, GIS, electronics, manufacturing and print preparation, depending on the chosen build. Features vary by platform and release. The Android guide covers its phone control, self-ADB, project Linux and external-editor workflows; Android CAD/3D preview is separate from the iOS modeling editor.

Models, permissions and privacy

Cloud model requests go directly to the provider you configure; supported local models perform inference on your device. Floe's maintainer does not provide a model API, model hosting or API credits. Credentials use protected device storage; uploads and remote actions follow the permissions you grant. Review AI-generated content before using it.

Disclaimer and usage terms · Security policy

Build from source

For iOS/iPadOS, use macOS, a full Xcode installation and XcodeGen. See the engineering guide for current SDK, dependency and signing requirements; iOS/iPadOS 26 remains a compatibility target.

git clone https://github.com/JiangNanGenius/floe-agent.git
cd floe-agent/FloeAgent
bash scripts/gen_project.sh
open FloeAgent.xcodeproj

iOS build guide · Android Full APK build guide · Mac Bridge build guide · iOS Bridge build guide

Gitee synchronizes source and release records. See the mirror guide.

Contributing and license

GitHub Issues is the main channel for feature requests and bug reports. Include your version, device and reproduction steps. In-app logs provide optional diagnostic material and are handled as time permits.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md before contributing. Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md.

Original Floe code is licensed under MPL 2.0. Third-party components retain their own licenses and notices, available in the app under Settings → Diagnostics & About → Third-Party Licenses.

skills.name: swift-mlx-lm
skills.description: MLX Swift LM - Run LLMs and VLMs on Apple Silicon using MLX. Covers local inference, streaming, wired memory coordination, tool calling, LoRA fine-tuning, embeddings, and model porting.

skills.name: floe-ios-bridge
skills.description: Operate an iPhone or iPad through Floe iOS Bridge — JSON-RPC 2.0 over localhost-first HTTP, paired with owner approval and encrypted per request. Use when the user asks to inspect or operate a phone, automate an iOS app, or check why Bridge cannot reach the device.

skills.name: floe-ios-automation
skills.description: Observe and control the current iPhone or iPad through the optional, self-signed Floe iOS Bridge companion on the same device. Use only after the user installs and enables this Skill and approves the local pairing inside Bridge.

skills.name: floe-network
skills.description: Device DNS, TCP, ICMP ping and traceroute diagnostics, LAN discovery, HTTP and downloads.

skills.name: floe-office
skills.description: Word, Excel and PowerPoint creation, verified OOXML text edits, engine edits with explicit capability limits, and file conversion.

skills.name: floe-pdf
skills.description: Native PDF editing, region reflow, images, forms, annotations, OCR and verified raster redaction.

skills.name: floe-video
skills.description: Inspect media and use verified video transcode, remux and audio conversion paths; check device and model readiness before processing.
